library(here)

# Import metadata and classifications from borgefjell

```{r}
# Enter variables
year <- 2024

# Import files
setwd("/run/user/210015540/gvfs/sftp:host=login.nird.sigma2.no,user=jwiel/nird/projects/NS11082K/national_monitoring/gbif/")
metadata_raw <- readr::read_delim(here::here("raw", "image_metadata", "national_monitoring_rodents_cameratraps_image_metadata_borgefjell_2024.txt"),
 delim = ";")

classif_raw <- readr::read_delim(here::here("raw", "image_classification_small_mammal_model_2025", "national_monitoring_rodents_cameratraps_image_classification_borgefjell_2024.txt"),
 delim = ";")

coord_raw <- readr::read_delim(here::here("raw", "Koordinates_SN_FI_RE_JO_KO_v2.csv"),
 delim = ";")

```

# Create resources

## Inspect raw data

```{r}
(unique_values_per_column <-
  metadata_raw %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ dplyr::n_distinct(.))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_unique"))

(unique_values_per_column <-
  classif_raw %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ dplyr::n_distinct(.))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_unique"))

(unique_values_per_column <-
  coord_raw %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ dplyr::n_distinct(.))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_unique"))
```

## Format information from metadata

```{r}
metadata <- metadata_raw

# Format captureMethod (per-row)
# Compute captureMethod for each row and store as a character vector
metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(captureMethod = dplyr::case_when(
    v_sequence == 0 ~ "timeLapse",
    v_sequence > 0  ~ "activityDetection",
    TRUE            ~ NA_character_
  ))

# Format timestamp to UTC
metadata$timestamp <- format(lubridate::ymd_hms(paste(metadata$t_date,metadata$t_time," "), tz = "CEST"), 
format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ")

 # Format deployment dates
 metadata <- metadata %>%
 dplyr::mutate(deploymentStart = min(timestamp),
 deploymentEnd = max(timestamp))

 ## Add coordinates to metadata
 # Transform the key column
coord <- coord_raw
coord <- coord %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sn_site = tolower(name)) %>% 
  mutate(sn_site = gsub("-", "_", sn_site))

# Merge columns from Koordinates into metadata
metadata <- metadata %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(coord, by = "sn_site")

# Create media filePath
metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(filePath = fs::path("national_monitoring", "images_renamed", sn_locality, sn_site, year,v_image_name))
  #TEST
  #setwd("/run/user/210015540/gvfs/sftp:host=login.nird.sigma2.no,user=jwiel/nird/projects/NS11082K/")
   # file.exists(path_wd(metadata$filePath[5]))

# Create eventID
metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(eventID = paste(v_trigger_mode, v_event, sep = "_"))

# Create event start and end
metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::group_by(eventID) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(eventStart = min(timestamp),
  eventEnd = max(timestamp)) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
  # Weird: 3310 unique eventID and unique eventStart and only 3305 unique eventEnd

```

## Format information from classifification

```{r}
classif <- classif_raw

# Add observationType
animal <- c("aves", "cricetidae", "lem_lem", "mus_erm", "mus_niv", "sor_sp", "unidentified_animal")
classif <- classif %>%
  dplyr::mutate(observationType = dplyr::case_when(
    v_class_id %in% animal      ~ "animal",
    v_class_id == "bad_quality" ~ "unknown",
    v_class_id == "empty"       ~ "blank",
    TRUE                        ~ "unclassified"
  ))

# Add scientificName
classif <- classif %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scientificName = dplyr::case_when(
    v_class_id == "aves"     ~ "Aves",
    v_class_id == "cricetidae" ~ "Cricetidae",
    v_class_id == "lem_lem"       ~ "Lemmus lemmus",
    v_class_id == "mus_erm"       ~ "Mustela erminea",
    v_class_id == "mus_niv"      ~ "Mustela nivalis",
    v_class_id == "sor_sp"      ~ "Sorex spp.",
    TRUE                        ~ NA_character_
  ))

  # Create observationID
classif <- classif %>%
  dplyr::group_by(v_image_name) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    observationID = paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(v_image_name), "_", row_number())
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Add event info from metadata
classif <- classif %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>% select(v_image_name, eventID, eventStart, eventEnd),
    by = "v_image_name"
  )

# Prioritize manual observation over automatic when both exist for same image
classif <- classif %>%
  dplyr::group_by(v_image_name) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(!is.na(v_presence_manual)), desc(!is.na(v_observer_manual))) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%  # Keep only the first row (manual if available, otherwise automatic)
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    classificationMethod = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(v_presence_manual) | !is.na(v_observer_manual) ~ "human",
      TRUE ~ "machine"
    )
  )
```

## Create deployments resource_start changes

```{r}
deployments <-
  metadata %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    deploymentID = metadata$sn_site, # Required
    locationID = NA_character_,
    locationName = metadata$sn_locality,
    latitude = metadata$lat, # Required
    longitude = metadata$lon, # Required
    coordinateUncertainty = NA_integer_,
    deploymentStart = metadata$deploymentStart, # Required
    deploymentEnd = metadata$deploymentEnd, # Required
    setupBy = NA_character_,
    cameraID = NA_character_,
    cameraModel = NA_character_,
    cameraDelay = 60,
    cameraHeight = NA_real_,
    cameraDepth = NA_real_,
    cameraTilt = -90,
    cameraHeading = NA_integer_,
    detectionDistance = NA_real_,
    timestampIssues = NA,
    baitUse = FALSE,
    featureType = NA_character_,
    habitat = metadata$sc_type_of_sites_ecological,
    deploymentGroups = NA_character_,
    deploymentTags = NA_character_,
    deploymentComments = NA_character_,
    .keep = "none") %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(deploymentID) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct(deploymentID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # Keep only first occurrence of each sn_site
  dplyr::select(
    deploymentID, locationID, locationName, latitude, longitude, 
    coordinateUncertainty, deploymentStart, deploymentEnd, setupBy, 
    cameraID, cameraModel, cameraDelay, cameraHeight, 
    cameraDepth, cameraTilt, cameraHeading, detectionDistance,
    timestampIssues, baitUse, featureType, habitat, deploymentGroups,
    deploymentTags, deploymentComments
  )
```

## Create media resource

```{r}
media <-
  metadata %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    mediaID = metadata$v_image_name, # Required
    deploymentID = metadata$sn_site, # Required
    captureMethod = as.character(metadata$captureMethod),
    timestamp = metadata$timestamp, # Required 
    filePath = metadata$filePath,# Required
    filePublic = FALSE, # Required
    fileName = NA_character_,
    fileMediatype = "image/jpeg", # Required
    exifData = NA,
    favorite = NA,
    mediaComments = metadata$v_comment,
    .keep = "none"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(mediaID) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    mediaID, deploymentID, captureMethod, timestamp, filePath, 
    filePublic, fileName, fileMediatype, exifData, favorite, mediaComments
  )
```

## Create observations resource

```{r}
observations <-
  classif %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    observationID = classif$observationID, # Required
    deploymentID = classif$sn_site, # Required
    mediaID = classif$v_image_name,
    eventID = classif$eventID,
    eventStart = classif$eventStart, # Required
    eventEnd = classif$eventEnd, # Required
    observationLevel = "media", # Required
    observationType = classif$observationType, # Required
    cameraSetupType = NA_character_,
    scientificName = classif$scientificName,
    count = NA_integer_,
    lifeStage = NA_character_,
    sex = NA_character_,
    behavior = NA_character_,
    individualID = NA_character_,
    individualPositionRadius = NA_real_,
    individualPositionAngle = NA_real_,
    individualSpeed = NA_real_,
    bboxX = NA_real_,
    bboxY = NA_real_,
    bboxWidth = NA_real_,
    bboxHeight = NA_real_,
    classificationMethod = classif$classificationMethod,
    classifiedBy = dplyr::case_when(
      classificationMethod == "human" ~ classif$v_observer_manual,
      TRUE ~ "Small_mammal_classification_model_version_2025"
    ),
    classificationTimestamp = NA_Date_,
    classificationProbability = classif$v_confidence_automatic,
    observationTags = NA_character_,
    observationComments = dplyr::case_when(
      classificationMethod == "human" ~ classif$v_type_manual_classification,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    .keep = "none"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(observationID) %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    observationID, deploymentID, mediaID, eventID, eventStart,
    eventEnd, observationLevel, observationType, cameraSetupType,
    scientificName, count, lifeStage, sex, behavior, individualID,
    individualPositionRadius, individualPositionAngle, individualSpeed,
    bboxX, bboxY, bboxWidth, bboxHeight, classificationMethod,
    classifiedBy, classificationTimestamp, classificationProbability,
    observationTags, observationComments
  )
```

# Write the three tables

```{r}
# Write CSV files with standard US format (comma separator, dot decimal)
write.csv(deployments, here::here("interim", "deployments.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(media, here::here("interim", "media.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(observations, here::here("interim", "observations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Inspect created tables
```{r}
classif_inspect <- (unique_values_per_column <-
  classif_raw %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ dplyr::n_distinct(.))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_unique"))

observations_inspect <-(unique_values_per_column <-
  observations %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ dplyr::n_distinct(.))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_unique"))

# Check unique scientificName values when observationType = "animal"
animal_observations <- observations %>%
  dplyr::filter(observationType == "animal")

animal_scientific_names <- animal_observations %>%
  dplyr::distinct(scientificName) %>%
  dplyr::pull(scientificName)

na_count <- sum(is.na(animal_observations$scientificName))
total_animal_obs <- nrow(animal_observations)

# Check number of "unidentified_animal" in original classification data
unidentified_animal_count <- sum(classif$v_class_id == "unidentified_animal", na.rm = TRUE)

print("Unique scientificName values when observationType = 'animal':")
print(animal_scientific_names)
print(paste("Number of NA values in scientificName for animal observations:", na_count))
print(paste("Total animal observations:", total_animal_obs))
print(paste("Percentage of NA values:", round(na_count/total_animal_obs * 100, 2), "%"))
print("---")
print(paste("Number of 'unidentified_animal' in classif$v_class_id:", unidentified_animal_count))
print(paste("Do NA count and unidentified_animal count match?", na_count == unidentified_animal_count))

# Find rows where eventStart exists but eventEnd is missing
rows_missing_eventEnd <- observations %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(eventStart) & is.na(eventEnd))

print("---")
print(paste("Number of rows with eventStart but missing eventEnd:", nrow(rows_missing_eventEnd)))

if(nrow(rows_missing_eventEnd) > 0) {
  print("Rows with missing eventEnd:")
  print(rows_missing_eventEnd)
}

# Find rows with identical eventEnd values
rows_with_duplicate_eventEnd <- observations %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(eventEnd)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(eventEnd) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n() > 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(eventEnd)

print("---")
print(paste("Number of rows with duplicated eventEnd values:", nrow(rows_with_duplicate_eventEnd)))

if(nrow(rows_with_duplicate_eventEnd) > 0) {
  print("Rows with identical eventEnd values:")
  print(rows_with_duplicate_eventEnd)
}

View(classif_inspect)
View(observations_inspect)


```
